# Vixx Delos Reyes

> Portfolio of Vixx Delos Reyes, an SEO professional with 14+ years of experience. SEO is the primary profession. AI media and video editing are additional services.

## Site

- [Home](https://vixxdelosreyes.github.io/): Vixx Delos Reyes is an SEO professional with 14+ years of hands-on experience in keyword research, technical SEO and AEO. Also creates AI media. Includes the Skillset overview and the Let's Talk contact form.
- [About](https://vixxdelosreyes.github.io/about/): The career behind Vixx Delos Reyes: 14+ years in SEO, now combining core SEO with AEO and AI media.
- [SEO](https://vixxdelosreyes.github.io/seo/): On-page, off-page and technical SEO, plus AEO work like llms.txt. Tools used and project proof from Vixx Delos Reyes, 14+ years in SEO.
- [AI Media](https://vixxdelosreyes.github.io/ai-media/): How Vixx Delos Reyes uses AI tools to make images and video for SEO, marketing and sales projects. Tools used and examples.
